## Purpose
Describe the issue and the smallest change that resolves it.

## Compatibility
State the tested Harness/Node versions and impacts on standalone installation,
dsh-env integration, other presets and upstream/fork behavior.

## Verification
List exact commands and results. Separate completed checks from untested claims.
Include installer ownership and real tool-result evidence when relevant.

## Attribution
Identify adapted upstream or third-party material and preserve its notices.
Do not include credentials, private profiles or generated dependency trees.
